**Finding submitted: MISSING (critical)**

The Agreement contains no indemnity provision of any kind — searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infringe" return nothing, Section 9 (Warranties) covers only corporate authority reps plus the Globix carve-out, and Section 10 (General Provisions) has no defence or hold-harmless language. Since HDI builds, hosts and supplies the software/technology for the Site, the absence of any vendor IP indemnity is walk-away territory and fails the fallback outright.

Redline (validated, ok:true): new Section 9(c) giving the Company the preferred HDI indemnity — third-party IP infringement claims, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused unauthorised access to Content/Confidential Information/user data, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct — with standard notice, control-of-defence (no adverse settlement without our consent) and cooperation-at-HDI's-expense mechanics. Placed inside Section 9 so it survives under Section 10.7. No Company indemnity was added; a narrow Content-only reciprocal indemnity, or the usual IP exclusions (Company Content, modifications, combinations), remain available as concessions.
